purpose: Research-only rejection screen for a manually executed multi-asset Aurel3 portfolio; no orders or notifications
capital_status: Illustrative test capital, not a recovered user budget
price_trend: Mean of positive 63/126/252-session trailing excess-return signs, relative to BIL. Allocate within each fixed group inversely to trailing 63-session volatility, then multiply by trend fraction. Unused budget stays in BIL. No leverage or shorts.
economic_trend: Price portfolio multiplied by 1 + 0.25 times an asset-group economic score, clipped to [0,1] at the signal level. Growth is sign of latest three first-release payroll changes minus preceding three; inflation is sign of latest three first-release CPI annualized changes minus preceding three. Equity/crypto: (growth-inflation)/2; bonds: (-growth-inflation)/2; commodities: (growth+inflation)/2; currencies: 0. Missing/stale macro is neutral. This is a deliberately simple hypothesis, not an AQR replication.
macro_availability: First-release values assumed usable 90 calendar days after observation month end; stress at 120 days. Publication timestamps are not in this dataset: this remains a timing assumption, not certified point-in-time data. Missing first releases are not filled using revised values.
ml: Expanding-window ridge on fixed nonlinear price/macro features, pooled across assets, refitted yearly. Learn 21-session forward excess returns divided by trailing volatility; train only on labels ending before the fit date. Minimum five years history and 500 rows. Fixed ridge penalty 10. Blend 50% economic trend score with 50% clipped predicted risk-adjusted return score. No language model or retrospective news.
rebalance: Last US trading session of each ISO week, signal after its close. ETFs execute next US session open; crypto executes at next UTC daily open AFTER that US opening date, avoiding mixed-time-zone lookahead. Delay stress uses third US session open, crypto another UTC day later.
sizing: Fractional research units. Suppress individual changes below max(USD100, 1% NAV). Allocate using only prior close risk estimates. Actual lot sizes/broker availability must be audited before live qualification.
cost_status: Conservative generic scenarios, not verified broker quotes; taxes, currency conversion and subscriptions excluded. Net means after modeled trading costs only.
inference: Use monthly block-bootstrap excess-return uncertainty; report overlapping rolling three-year windows descriptively. Track all tested variants. No claim that the inspected recent period is a pristine holdout. Failed return/drawdown hurdle is sufficient to reject; passing this screen is not deployment approval.
scope_limits: Only long/cash retail proxies and spot BTC/ETH; no futures/option/FX margin simulation
Surviving proxy universe chosen today; no comprehensive historical tradable universe
Crypto selected ex post; report no-crypto ablation
USD base; user-specific tax, FX and lot feasibility outstanding
Daily crypto marks are UTC, ETF marks US close; stagger fills and disclose mixed valuation times
Historic adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not literal historical order prices
No claim of a globally best strategy
